description: Blue Team SOC Analysts are tasked with detecting and responding to a ransomware attack targeting a finance department workstation. intent.title: Executive summary
intent.text: This exercise is a four-hour SOC Analyst training session conducted on a cyber range. The Blue Team is tasked with detecting and containing a ransomware attack targeting a finance department workstation within the FinTech Global/Nebula Group environment. The team will face challenges including high volumes of false-positive alerts and limited personnel. Success is measured by the ability to triage alerts within 15 minutes, initiate containment within 30 minutes of confirmation, and provide hourly status updates. The scenario involves an organized adversary using standard ransomware techniques, progressing from workstation-level alerts to potential domain-wide escalation.
